title: Dr. Hollis pours out soulful worship in new single “Overflow”
htmlContent:
Dr. Hollis brings forth a refreshing wave of faith and hope with his new single, "Overflow." This song is more than just music. It's a heartfelt expression of surrender and renewal that captures listeners with warm melodies and honest lyrics. "Overflow" creates a sense of closeness and connection.

Dr. Hollis sings with deep emotion, sharing his journey through struggles and finding redemption. The gentle piano and uplifting harmonies reflect the journey from feeling empty to experiencing abundance. The lyrics speak to the heart, illustrating how God fills our broken places with endless love. Dr. Hollis openly addresses the real challenges of faith, mental health, and life's uncertainties. He welcomes listeners into a vulnerable space where feelings of both longing and grace come together.

https://open.spotify.com/album/6MQzUEWJAESwLED2MIKMQj?si=EMarmSYARNmzr_5nGejonw

This song is worship in its truest form, personal, open, and deeply touching. For anyone searching for encouragement and upliftment, "Overflow" reminds us that God's love can fill us up even in our toughest times. Dr. Hollis has created a song of renewal that will resonate with anyone looking for peace during life's challenges.
